profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer in Azure at Microsoft

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Languages and Tools Used: C#, PowerShell, Kusto Query Language, Git, HTML

-Created C# application to run queries on Azure logs, extract relevant information, and display insights to end users.
-Reduced application run time from three minutes to less than twenty seconds by refactoring code to run queries in parallel.
-Developed dashboard using Kusto Query Language to be used by software engineers as a diagnostic tool. Dashboard is in production and has received positive feedback from end users.

positions.title: Applications Development Intern
positions.description:
Languages and Tools Used: Python, Selenium, Java 8, Spring Boot, Git

-Created web scraping programs to retrieve data on companies’ board of directors meetings. Successfully scraped over 415,000 meeting agenda items.
-Set up architecture to transition internal employee website from PHP to Java.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Languages and Tools Used: Java 8, Spring Boot, JSON, Maven, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Mockito, Agile Methodology

-Developed high priority features for new technology platform using Spring Boot. The features involved retrieving data from an Oracle database and sending requests to an external partner service.
-Created company-wide documentation describing architecture, benefits, and APIs of distributed caching technologies including Couchbase and Redis.
-Recommended distributed caching solution for new PayPal Credit platform to Technology Lead based on research performed. This cache will be used to retrieve existing accounts for international PayPal Credit users.
-Created proof of concept to test idempotency in distributed cache.

positions.title: Senior Advisory Consultant
positions.description:
Supported federal clients with audit readiness efforts including:
-mock audit testing
-developing corrective action plans
-creating documentation describing client business processes

Lead a team of two consultants in reviewing Notifications of Findings and Recommendations and Corrective Action Plans

positions.title: Audit Associate
positions.description:
-Performed substantive testing for financial statement areas including accounts receivable, revenue, expenses, etc.
-Executed substantive analytical procedures for quarterly review of international public companies
-Prepared internal control narratives
-Examined evidence of proper design and implementation of key controls
-Communicated audit recommendations to management
